content.title: About
content.content: Pineapple juice, 100% is a pure juice extracted from ripe pineapples without added sugar, preservatives or flavorings. It has a bright sweet‑tart taste, characteristic tropical aroma and a rich golden colour.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Pineapple contains the enzyme bromelain, which helps break down proteins.
The fruit is cultivated in over 80 countries, with Costa Rica, the Philippines and Thailand being the largest producers.
Pineapple juice is often used in marinades because bromelain tenderises meat.
A single serving (250 ml) provides more than 100% of the daily recommended vitamin C.
In ancient cultures pineapple was a symbol of hospitality and luxury.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system, aids collagen synthesis and acts as a powerful antioxidant.

items.title: Contains bromelain
items.content: The bromelain enzyme improves digestion, reduces inflammation and may aid recovery after exercise.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B1, B6 and folate contribute to energy metabolism and nervous system health.

items.title: Hydration support
items.content: Being almost 90% water, the juice helps maintain proper fluid balance.

items.title: Provides potassium
items.content: Potassium supports normal heart and muscle function and regulates fluid balance.

items.title: Bromelain allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to bromelain, such as swelling, itching or hives.

items.title: High natural sugar content
items.content: Even without added sugar, the natural sugars can be a concern for people with diabetes or low‑carb diets.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: The acidic nature of the juice may irritate the stomach lining in people with gastritis or ulcers.

items.title: Interaction with medication
items.content: Bromelain can enhance the effect of anticoagulants, so consult a doctor if you are on blood‑thinning medication.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Drink the juice chilled as a refreshing beverage, add it to smoothies, cocktails, sauces and marinades. To reduce acidity, dilute with water or mix with mint.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the juice in the refrigerator at 1 °C–4 °C. Once opened, consume within 3–5 days. Do not keep at room temperature for more than 12 hours to prevent spoilage.
